rev.t:
Located at Koramangala, just on the left side of main road. It's just opposite to Croma.
Very neat and clean shopping mall with plenty of shopping options.
Only issue is there is no restaurant or food court except a donut centre.

Oasis Mall is a great spot for shopping with a wide range of popular brands under one roof. The best part is the frequent discount sales, making it a budget friendly choice for fashion and essentials. The mall has a clean, spacious layout …
